name: aavkar-educational-motion-studio
description: Aavkar Educational Motion Studio (AEM): observes and records educational animation work. It remembers (the client's rulings at the level they gave them, approvals tied to the exact render, the critic's labelled cases), measures (time per stage and moment) and checks (every render, with evidence the agent can see), and never blocks work; it asks once, before a delivery of a render with no current approval. Every decision is made by the aem CLI.

aemPath.title: aem command
aemPath.description: Path or name of the aem command. Left as 'aem', the plugin also tries ~/.local/bin/aem.

reviewInbox.title: Review inbox
reviewInbox.description: Adds /inbox: a pane listing what waits on you (plan rows, stills, renders, imported client comments) with approve and reject buttons. Off by default.
